name: QIDI Odorless-ABS Rapido @BBL A1
filament_notes:
QIDI manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Manufacturer recommends an enclosure; this printer is open-frame.
Product page: bed 100-110 C PEI, speed 80-300 mm/s, fan 0-60 %, nozzle >=0.2 mm, retraction 1-5 mm, enclosed printer required, 'Active chamber heating recommended, 55-80 C if the printer has a heated chamber' (55 recorded as minimum), drying 70-80 C 4-6 h, support: S-White. Nozzle 240-260 C from comparison guide (page gives none). Density 1.05 and HDT 92 C from older wiki table (which grouped it with ABS Rapido at 250-280 C, chamber 50 C).
Source: https://qidi3d.com/products/qidi-tech-odorless-abs-rapido-filament
